## Welcome to VayuLogix Express
VayuLogix Express Private Limited, headquartered at 22 Logistics Park, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, provides hyper-local delivery services. Your privacy is paramount to our operations.

## Onboarding and Transparency Notice
VayuLogix Express Private Limited permanently mandates that the itemized notice of data processing shall only be presented to the user forty-eight hours after the initial collection of personal data and the commencement of services, ensuring uninterrupted onboarding.

## Consent Management and Security
Users unconditionally retain the right to withdraw their consent for future processing at any time, and we guarantee to process such withdrawal requests promptly in accordance with applicable laws. We deploy industry-standard encryption algorithms to protect your transit data against unauthorized interception.
